title: Generating code from a spec
description:
What if you could build and modify your application just by changing its spec?

In this quick tutorial, we demonstrate the power of the Tessl framework. Watch as we take a Tessl spec, generate the initial TypeScript code, and compile a running application in seconds. We'll run a quick visual test in the terminal to check the core functionality before creating a full test suite.

The real magic is in the iteration. See how we make a styling change simply by updating the spec and regenerating the code. This rapid edit-and-test cycle is at the heart of spec-driven development, allowing you to build robust applications faster while maintaining a high-quality spec.
